bjorgur_1.m: Hello there. You wouldn't happen to know anything about a grave to the southwest of Prim would you?
r: I have been there. I met someone on one of the lower levels.

bjorgur_3.m: My family grave is located in the tomb to the southwest of Prim right outside the Elm mine. I fear that something has disturbed the peace there.

bjorgur_4.m: You see, my grandfather was very fond of a particular valuable dagger that our family used to possess. He wore it with him always.

bjorgur_5.m: The dagger would of course attract treasure hunters, but up until now we seem to have been spared of this.

bjorgur_6.m: Now I fear something has happened to the grave. I have not been sleeping well the last couple of nights, and I am sure this must be the cause.

bjorgur_7.m: You wouldn't happen to want to go check on the grave and see what is happening over there?
r: Sure. I will go check on your parents grave.
A treasure you say? I'm interested.
I have actually already been there and restored the dagger to its original place.

bjorgur_8.m: Thank you. Please see if anything has happened to the grave, and what could be the cause of my nightly anxiety.

bjorgur_9.m: Please hurry, and return here to tell me of your progress once you find out something.

bjorgur_complete_1.m: An intruder? Oh thank you for dealing with this matter.

bjorgur_complete_2.m: You say you restored the dagger to it's original place? Thank you. Now I might be able to rest during the nights ahead.

bjorgur_complete_3.m: Thank you again. I'm afraid I can't give you anything except my gratitude. You should go see my relatives in Feygard if you get the chance to travel up there.

bjorgur_return_1.m: Hello again, friend. Thank you for your assistance with my family grave earlier.

bjorgur_return_2.m: Hello again. Have you investigated if anything has happened to my family grave?
r: [Lie] I went to check on the grave. Everything seems to be normal. You must be imagining things.
What was I supposed to do again?
Yes. I killed the intruder and restored the dagger to its original place.

bjorgur_return_3.m: Nothing you say? But I was sure something must have happened over there. Anyway. Thank you for checking it for me.

bjorgur_grave.10: Bjorgur in Prim at the base of the Blackwater mountain thinks that something has disturbed the grave of his parents, to the southwest of Prim, just outside the Elm mine.
bjorgur_grave.15: Bjorgur wants me to go check the grave, and make sure his family's dagger is still secure in the tomb.
bjorgur_grave.20: Fulus in Prim is interested in obtaining Bjorgur's family dagger that Bjorgur's grandfather used to possess.
bjorgur_grave.30: I met a man that wielded a strange looking dagger in the lower parts of a tomb to the southwest of Prim. He must have robbed this dagger from the grave.
bjorgur_grave.40: I placed the dagger back into its place in the tomb. The restless undead seem much less restless now, strangely enough.
bjorgur_grave.50: Bjorgur thanked me for my assistance. He told me I should also seek his relatives in Feygard.
bjorgur_grave.51: I have told Fulus that I helped Bjorgur return his family dagger to its original place.
bjorgur_grave.60: I have given Bjorgur's family dagger to Fulus. He thanked me for bringing it to him, and rewarded me handsomely.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
